hero.heading: Thank you to our Devcon 8 supporters
hero.body_line_1: The Supporters Program is how teams across the ecosystem contributed to Devcon 8
hero.body_line_2: and took their place within it.

community_banner.prefix: Devcon is built by the teams that

points.title: Be present, not just listed
points.body: Supporter teams were part of the event. They were in the space, engaging with attendees, and recognized as the projects that made Devcon possible.

points.title: Community of shared principles
points.body: Supporters joined people who care about the same things they do; open systems, privacy, and the long-term health of shared infrastructure.

points.title: Put your principles into practice
points.body: Devcon exists to serve the ecosystem, not extract from it. Supporting was a way to put resources behind the things the community actually cares about.

what_is.heading: What is the Supporters Program?
what_is.body_p1: The Supporters Program is how ecosystem projects contributed to Devcon 8 and participated in it.
what_is.body_p2_strong: Supporter teams were part of the event
what_is.body_p2_rest: – present in the space, visible to the community, and recognized alongside the projects that make Devcon possible. Instead of a traditional sponsorship, it was an opportunity to give back to the ecosystem and be part of the conference.

impact.heading: Impact Program
impact.body_strong: Free and open source. Public goods. Non-profits.
impact.body_intro: Some of the most important work doesn't have a budget – across Ethereum and beyond. Impact Booths were free booth spaces reserved for these teams. The Impact Program offered two ways to participate:

tracks.body: A free physical booth space at Devcon 8 for FOSS projects and non-profits contributing to Ethereum's public infrastructure.
Digital presence on Devcon's platforms and a set of tickets to attend, for aligned entities.
